label: baseline
description: Unchanged humans, as the old ships carried them: quick to learn.

label: Impid
description: A lineage made for hot worlds: red skin, small horns, untouched by heat and fire, quick on its feet but thin-skinned.
note: sneed 2026-11-19 (docs/design/races.md): his Impid stats replace the wiki's gene list (very fast runner, weak immunity and the rest). The label is sneed's name for it; the defName stays.

label: Orcoid
description: Big, hard to kill and strong in a fight, but slow to learn and slow at work.

label: drow
description: Dark-skinned, platinum-haired and red-eyed people of the dark: sharp shots and quick hands at night, troubled by the sun.
later: red irises and long pointed ears: drawn by Unreal from the lineage

label: cat-strain
description: Beast-strain people with a cat's ears, tail and claws: great leapers and climbers who land on their feet, but every hurt hits them harder.

label: Frostkin
description: A lineage made for cold worlds: thick fur, a strong frame and a short temper.

label: Warbred
description: A lineage made for war: quick to heal, hard to hurt and eager to fight.
later: go-juice (rush) dependency gene, with drugs in Stage 3
the wiki gives complexity 16 on the Xenotypes page and 17 on the Hussar page

label: Ashborn
description: A lineage made for ruined worlds: gray, hard to sicken and at home in poisoned air.
later: pollution stimulus, wake-up (rush-like drug) immunity and psychite dependency genes, with pollution and drugs

label: Delver
description: A lineage made for the dark under mountains: sharp in the dark, fast to heal, slow on the surface.
